established: An **actor id** is a non-empty string of at most 200 code points, in Unicode Normalization Form C, with no control character (general category Cc) and no white space (Unicode White_Space) at either end.
residual: this record cites its witness cases and mutants and does not run them; CI runs the suites and tests/mutants.py before tools/claims.py check
NFC is judged under the implementation's Unicode version (Python unicodedata); a string with unassigned code points may stop being NFC under a later version
format characters (Cf, e.g. U+200B, U+202E) are allowed anywhere: "claude" followed by U+200B is another actor; only Cc and edge white space are refused
